content.title: Experience The Charm Of Iowa City And Surrounding Areas
content.text: SOMEWHERE TOWrite home about Welcome to Iowa City and our collection of compelling communities Some places are built to be seen. Iowa City, Coralville, and North Liberty, Iowa, are meant to be experienced and remembered. This is where curiosity sparks conversations, and ideas aren’t just exchanged; they’re elevated. Whether wandering through literary landmarks, diving into bold flavors, or soaking in the energy of a city that thinks big, you’ll see that what happens here will linger in your mind long after you leave. Because this isn’t just a place to visit — it’s somewhere to write home about. What’s here. what’s there explore Not all who wander are lost, but here’s a map of Iowa City, Coralville, and North Liberty, just in case. There are no algorithms, no rerouting—just a simple way to see what’s where so you can get the lay of our land. Centennial Park Iowa’s Children’s Museum Iowa River Landing Hancher Auditorium Old Capitol Kinnick Stadium Downtown Iowa City Terry Trueblood Recreation Area Centennial Park Opening in fall 2025, the expansive Centennial Park will feature an amphitheater, innovative playground, and versatile gathering spaces—adding another jewel to this rapidly evolving community. Learn More Iowa’s Children’s Museum The ICM is located inside the Coral Ridge Mall and inspires kids to imagine, create, discover, & explore through The Power of Play! Learn More Iowa River Landing This walkable district seamlessly combines shopping and relaxation with scenic views of the Iowa River, creating an inviting destination for visitors and locals alike. Learn More Hancher Auditorium A premier performing arts venue on the University of Iowa campus offering dramatic architecture, top-tier acoustics, and flexible spaces for lectures, keynotes, and upscale receptions. Learn More Old Capitol Located at the center of the University of Iowa, this historic site offers immersive group tours that explore Iowa’s political past and its influence on the present day. Learn More Kinnick Stadium Iconic home of the Iowa Hawkeyes football. Named after Heisman trophy winner Nile Kinnick. Learn More Downtown Iowa City Downtown Iowa City is a vibrant and walkable business and entertainment district located directly across from the University of Iowa campus with many locally owned restaurants, shops, and entertainment options. Learn More Terry Trueblood Recreation Area Enjoy a sweeping view of prairie land on 152 acres with a paved trail 1.8 mile trail loop around its lake that is popular with birders, cyclists and runners. Learn More IOWACITY CORALVILLE IOWA YOU ARE HERE let’s find things to do Curiosity doesn’t sit still. Neither should you. Luckily, our Iowa City, Coralville, and North Liberty are packed with things to do. Fresh air, meet fresh perspective. Attractions From legendary landmarks to quirky must-sees, our attractions aren’t just photo ops — they’re conversation starters. Go beyond the obvious and discover the places that make our communities unforgettable. LEARN MORE ➜ Outdoor Adventure Whether you’re hitting the trails, paddling peaceful waters, or chasing the perfect sunset, nature here doesn’t just surround you — it shapes your story. Let’s get outside and see where it takes you. LEARN MORE ➜ Arts & Culture Here, creativity lives on every stage, gallery wall, and page. With a pulse on the past and a passion for what’s next, our cultural scene will leave you inspired long after the final act. LEARN MORE ➜ A Literary Lover’s Dream For more than 90 years, Iowa City has been teaching the world to write. The Iowa Writers’ Workshop at the University of Iowa pioneered the teaching of creative writing at the university level. Dozens of creative programs within the university and the city followed. The newest chapter in this tradition is Iowa City’s designation as a UNESCO City of Literature. what’s happening this month In a place that celebrates ideas, culture, and creativity, there’s always something worth showing up for. So start exploring what’s happening this weekend, this month, and throughout the year in Iowa City, Coralville, and North Liberty.
